labels.variantDefinition: A grid of OpenType feature cards, each with a toggle and input→output samples; the chosen set compiles into a copyable settings line or custom font build
labels.look: Pale blue-grey docs page, intro prose, monospace settings bar with Copy, 4-column cards (calt, liga, dlig, cv01…) listing sequence→glyph pairs
labels.ux: Toggle each feature group; the editor.fontLigatures line updates; copy to clipboard
labels.learn: End the feature tour with a copy-paste config: the visitor leaves with their exact setup, not just an impression

labels.variantDefinition: Each style or optical size gets a thin divider label and one or two editable sample lines at a size chosen for it; click to type, no toolbar
labels.look: Black, grey stencil-like display lines ('JUPITER-2', 'LIQUID MERCURY') shrinking from Giga to Nano, hairline dividers with style names
labels.ux: Every line is contenteditable; each set at its own opsz value
labels.learn: Set each optical size at the size it was drawn for, so the ramp itself explains the optical-size system

labels.look: White, Hebrew character set (letters, dagesh/niqqud forms, figures, fractions, punctuation) in a ruled grid, RTL order
labels.learn: Lay the grid out right-to-left for a Hebrew set so reading order matches the script

labels.look: White, huge black serif words (Grand, Flowing, Order, Raison, Feather) stepping up in weight, cropped right; narrow prose column left
labels.learn: Pair a weight ramp of single words with a skinny design-rationale column: specimen and argument side by side

labels.look: White, black headline 'the interesting boring sans', magenta-ruled licence-size cards (Mini…Testing), preview text field
labels.ux: Pick licence size, type preview text, choose weights/packages, add to cart
labels.learn: Name licence tiers by real usage limits (pageviews, apps) so buyers choose without reading a EULA

labels.look: Black, pink display place names with tiny style switches above a teal ruled glyph grid paginated by 100 (0-99…700-729)
labels.ux: Click Poltergeist/Alpha/Beta to restyle each word; page through the glyph set in hundreds
labels.learn: Paginate a large glyph set in fixed chunks so each glyph stays big enough to read

labels.variantDefinition: One shared control bar (style, axes, size) pinned above drives all the sample lines below it
labels.look: White graph-paper grid, sticky Width and Weight sliders with red dots, editable waterfall of tech-history sentences cut at the edge
labels.ux: Width and Weight sliders change the whole waterfall; every line is editable
labels.learn: Two global axis sliders over a size waterfall show how width and weight hold up from caption to display at once

labels.look: White, blue bold phone numbers stacked between thick blue rules, floating site badge
labels.learn: Use a single real-world content type (phone numbers) to show figures under realistic repetition

labels.look: Grey 'off' line above black 'on' line, orange toggle marked DEFAULT, '[liga]' tag and short history note
labels.ux: Toggle ligatures on and off on a Spanish sample
labels.learn: Mark which state is the default, so readers know what they get without touching anything
